"""Stage-A independent record audit and regression witnesses; no native FE."""
from pathlib import Path
import ast
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from unittest.mock import patch

import numpy as np
import pytest

ROOT = Path.cwd()
OUT = ROOT / "tmp/task42extra/review_v25_A"
T0 = time.monotonic()
assert os.environ["TASK42EXTRA_ENV_MODE"] == "pure"
assert sys.executable.startswith(str(ROOT / ".venv"))
assert not any(x in sys.modules for x in ("dolfinx", "petsc4py", "torch"))
SOURCE = "6e0913810d42450eb0b899b46389b8b014bd8883"
HEAD = "4152f0e1fb4e2a20f65643adc82cee19f66e87b8"
assert subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip() == HEAD

def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())

def binding(path):
    p = Path(path).resolve()
    return {"path": str(p.relative_to(ROOT)), "bytes": p.stat().st_size,
            "sha256": hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}

record = read(ROOT / "docs/task042extra_feinn_5nm/outcomes/records/stage_A_v26.json")
occurrences = []
files = {}
def walk(obj, at="stage_A"):
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        if {"path", "bytes", "sha256"} <= obj.keys():
            p = Path(obj["path"])
            assert p.is_file(), at
            b = binding(p)
            assert (b["bytes"], b["sha256"]) == (obj["bytes"], obj["sha256"]), at
            occurrences.append({"source": at, **b}); files[b["path"]] = b
        for k, v in obj.items():
            walk(v, at + "/" + k)
    elif isinstance(obj, list):
        for i, v in enumerate(obj):
            walk(v, at + "/" + str(i))
walk(record)
source_rows = record["tested_source_files"] + record["A_qualification_content"]["test_source_files"] + record["inputs"]
for item in source_rows:
    p = Path(item["path"])
    original = subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", SOURCE + ":" + str(p.relative_to(ROOT))])
    assert original == p.read_bytes()
junit = []
for row in record["tests"]:
    tree = ET.parse(row["junit"]["path"]).getroot()
    suites = [tree] if tree.tag == "testsuite" else list(tree.findall("testsuite"))
    counts = {k: sum(int(s.attrib.get(k, 0)) for s in suites) for k in ("tests", "failures", "errors", "skipped")}
    assert counts == row["counts"]
    summary = read(row["summary"]["path"])
    for k in ("classification", "leader_exit_code", "descendants_cleared", "elapsed_seconds",
              "sampled_process_tree_rss_peak_bytes", "sampled_process_tree_swap_peak_bytes"):
        assert summary[k] == row[k]
    junit.append({"name": row["name"], "counts": counts, "classification": summary["classification"]})
old = "afea8f4c7d0a9b6d42b5c3024e2ca47a026ee0ee"
protected = []
for name in subprocess.check_output(["git", "ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", old, "docs/task042extra_feinn_5nm"], text=True).splitlines():
    assert subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", old + ":" + name]) == (ROOT / name).read_bytes()
    protected.append(name)

from src.io.w1_evidence import validate_A
from src.io.w1_receiver_contract import load_w1
from src.runners import w1_component_receiver as receiver
from src.runners import w1_component_payload as payload
from src.solvers import w1_boundary_components as component
from src.solvers.w1_local_export_patch import export_source
from src.test import test_w1_scientific_chain as fixtures

qualification = validate_A(record["A_qualification"]["path"], {p: receiver.digest(ROOT / p) for p in receiver.RECEIVER_FILES})
assert qualification["scope"] == "PURE_LOGIC_ONLY"
base = subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", receiver.MATH_COMMIT + ":src/solvers/task40_w1_local_probe.py"], text=True)
exported = export_source(base)
assert exported.encode() == Path(record["minimal_export_overlay"]["preview"]["path"]).read_bytes()
def solve_count(source):
    return sum(isinstance(n, ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func, ast.Name) and n.func.id == "lu_solve"
               for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(source)))
assert solve_count(base) == solve_count(exported) == 5

# Actual fixed consumer/writer on explicitly synthetic, non-Hermitian arrays.
# The input-builder fixtures stub Basix/direct integrals; no native qualification.
local = []
for p, side in ((4, "top"), (4, "bottom"), (6, "top"), (6, "bottom")):
    folder = OUT / ("case_p" + str(p) + "_" + side); folder.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    with pytest.MonkeyPatch.context() as mp:
        fixtures.directional.__wrapped__(mp)
        arrays, modes, producer, save = fixtures.local_fixture(folder, mp, p, side)
        state = fixtures.live_guard(f"p{p}_{side}_check")
        positive = payload.check_local(component, producer, folder, state, modes)
        assert positive["status"] == "P2_SAVED_LOCAL_PASS"
        payload.atomic_json(folder / "positive.json", positive)
        assert read(folder / "positive.json")["status"] == "P2_SAVED_LOCAL_PASS"
        negatives = []
        for key in ("qhat_alpha", "affine_internal_rhs", "reduced_trace_matrix", "reduced_trace_rhs"):
            original = arrays[key].copy()
            arrays[key].flat[0] += 1e6
            save()
            negative = payload.check_local(component, producer, folder, state, modes)
            assert negative["status"] == "P2_SAVED_LOCAL_FAIL"
            payload.atomic_json(folder / (key + "_negative.json"), negative)
            negatives.append({"field": key, "status": negative["status"],
                              "failed_metrics": {k: v for k, v in negative["metrics"].items()
                                                 if v["relative"] > negative["metric_limits"][k]}})
            arrays[key] = original
        save()
        local.append({"degree": p, "side": side,
                      "positive_max_relative": max(m["relative"] for m in positive["metrics"].values()),
                      "positive_status": positive["status"], "negative_count": len(negatives),
                      "negative_results": negatives})

chain = OUT / "gate"; chain.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
gate = []
with pytest.MonkeyPatch.context() as mp:
    output, spec, _, publish = fixtures.scientific_chain(chain, mp)
    receiver.prerequisite("p4_top", output, spec)
    for name in ("control", "boundary_check"):
        previous = {p.name: p.read_bytes() for p in (output / name).iterdir() if p.is_file()}
        result = read(output / name / "component_result.json")
        publish(name, result, {"classification":"RSS_HARD_STOP", "leader_exit_code":137,
                              "descendants_cleared":False, "remaining_child_pids":[123],
                              "sampled_process_tree_swap_peak_bytes":0})
        try:
            receiver.prerequisite("p4_top", output, spec)
        except ValueError as error:
            gate.append({"stage":name, "error":str(error)})
        else:
            raise AssertionError("failed supervisor still accepted")
        for name2, data in previous.items():
            (output / name / name2).write_bytes(data)
assert len(gate) == 2

# Missing-real-input public wrapper must not create its B clock or launch.
spec = load_w1(ROOT / "input/task042extra_feinn_5nm/v26_w1_control.dat")
assert not Path(spec["window_path"]).exists()
before = sorted(str(p) for p in (ROOT / "tmp/task42extra/durable").glob("*"))
missing = receiver.durable_w1(spec)
after = sorted(str(p) for p in (ROOT / "tmp/task42extra/durable").glob("*"))
assert missing["scope"] == "B_NOT_STARTED_INPUT_UNAVAILABLE"
assert before == after and not Path(spec["window_path"]).exists()

receipt = {"schema":"review-v25-stage-A-independent.v1", "head":HEAD, "tested_source":SOURCE,
           "bindings":occurrences, "binding_occurrences":len(occurrences), "unique_files":len(files),
           "source_and_input_files_matching_tested_commit":len(source_rows),
           "JUnit":junit, "old_task_files_unchanged":len(protected), "old_task_files":protected,
           "A_qualification_read_back":"PURE_LOGIC_ONLY", "exported_source_exact":True,
           "original_and_exported_solve_call_sites":[solve_count(base),solve_count(exported)],
           "local_synthetic_actual_checker":local, "failed_supervision_rejected":gate,
           "public_missing_input":missing,"B_window_created":False,"new_durable_directories":0,
           "scope":"actual unmodified functions; synthetic algebra and explicit Basix/direct-integral stubs, not FE",
           "new_native_FE_calls":0,"new_LU_or_solve_calls":0,"new_NN_calls":0,
           "seconds":time.monotonic()-T0}
payload.atomic_json(OUT / "audit_result.json", receipt)
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in receipt.items() if k not in ("bindings","old_task_files","local_synthetic_actual_checker")}))
